fields.label: Is Default
fields.description: Used when a run or agent does not pick a provider. Only one provider can be default.

fields.label: Provider Type
fields.description: All types speak the OpenAI chat-completions protocol; DeepSeek, Groq, OpenRouter, Gemini-compat and Ollama are 'OpenAI Compatible' / 'Ollama' with a Base URL.

fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1 (leave empty for OpenAI)

fields.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Leave empty to use AI Settings

fields.label: Default Model
fields.description: Falls back to the row marked Default in the table, then to AI Settings

fields.label: Available Models
fields.description: These appear in the Agent Workspace model picker for this provider.
